slug: 2026-07-09 Nigerian Government Intensifies National Identity Enrolment Campaign (Voice of Nigeria)

systems.country_label: National Identity Database; ward-by-ward enrolment exercise
systems.tiers: more than 136 million enrolled and about 100 million still to be; enrolment begun across 8,809 political wards; systems integrated with more than 250 ministries, departments and agencies; the National Orientation Agency, present in all 774 local government areas, to drive awareness

note: National identity enrolment by a federal commission: the presence in the 774 local government areas is a federal agency's; nothing on local government offices or their connection.
